notes.note: #0.24-0.31 (0.24/0.25 in story_076) are the Ultra-leader pairs; 0435.bla checks ids 11,12,14,15 = Ultraman, Seven, Mebius, Zero, so #0.26/27 Seven, #0.28/29 Mebius (polite), #0.30/31 Zero. Zero's pair is identical to Ultraman's in the source, so identical English. Dropped subject restored as 'we' (the party).
Dai-3-sou rendered 'Floor 3' per the 'Floor 1' precedent (story_070/076 venue boards). Ultra Tower is not in the glossary.

#0.37-0.45 non-Ultra leader variants. 0435.bla check order 5,4,2,1,3,6,7,9,10 = OOO, W, Black RX, Rider 1, Den-O, Nu, Zeta, Wing Zero, 00. #0.37 OOO (addresses Ankh), #0.38 W (casual), #0.44-0.45 Wing Zero/00 (curt). The rough slot 3 (#0.39, and #0.51) reads like Momotaros but falls on Black RX by that order; voiced by wording (rough) either way. Possible script/order mismatch, as in story_066.
On-screen timer; full-width spacing replaced by 'Time Left: '.
Ankh repeating the leader's 'under two hours' line as a question in the non-Ultra branch; subject 'we' restored.
#0.49-0.57 same non-Ultra order: #0.49 OOO (adds '!'), #0.51 rough slot (RX per check order, Momotaros-like wording). Identical Japanese -> identical English.

#0.2-0.14 thirteen identical leader gasps. 0436.bla check order 5,4,3,15,14,6,7,2,1,11,12,9,10 = OOO, W, Den-O, Zero, Mebius, Nu, Zeta, RX, Rider 1, Ultraman, Seven, Wing Zero, 00 (confirmed: slot 5 Mebius adds -san at #0.33).
Uva admiring the Kabuto Yummy (it grows by feeding on desire); 'it' = the Yummy (g=n).
Ankh deliberately trails off: he guesses Uva means to revive Mezool and Gamel with the Cell Medals; Uva confirms next row.
'Hamerareta' = were trapped/set up; rendered 'got played by Kazari'.
'Toriaikko' is a childish word for a scramble/tug-of-war; Ankh is mocking, rendered 'squabbling over medals'.
Mebius slot uses Ankh-san; honorific dropped per style, so same English as the other slots.
Source has a typo (a kanji resembling 'afureru' = overflowing); read as 'overflowing'.
#0.45/#0.46 are not shown by 0436.bla (script goes #0.44 -> #0.47); unused alternates of Uva's line, voiced as Uva.
'If (someone) goes to the finals' has no subject; Uva is a tournament entrant chasing desires, so 'I' restored. Could also be read as 'we'/'you'.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader variants mapped from 0435.bla/0436.bla Pt_Chara_Check order; 0435 rough slot 3 (#0.39, #0.51) falls on Black RX by check order but reads like Momotaros (voiced rough). 0436 #0.45/#0.46 unused alternates. #0.49 subject 'I' restored (inferred). Not in glossary: Ultra Tower; 'Floor 3' follows 'Floor 1' precedent.
